## Outcome
anth.us and www.anth.us are served from the Anth.us projection bucket through papyrus-edge-anth-us (E3UMOOJRMY7FK7) with parity to today's site, including all 402 redirects; the Amplify reader d15dpu9buefmq0 is no longer used.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 9 (Migration, Anth.us).

## Interim state
CMS-driven Amplify reader on branch cms-parity (PR AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus#25) until this epic's cutover.

## Checklist
- [ ] Anth.us SiteProjector refactor; gate: project_all equals today's build from the same export (byte-identical; in-process Markus already proven byte-identical on 2,352 files)
- [ ] 401 generated redirect rules + pattern rules in KVS/function; 404 behaviour; robots and sitemap; headers
- [ ] Test distribution parity: /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/anthus-live-20261011 compare (93 paths, normalized HTML) plus all 402 redirects (status and Location); renditions by dimensions and visual diff
- [ ] Ryan's yes; origin swap in a chosen window; rollback = swap back
- [ ] Quiet week, then hand d15dpu9buefmq0 to Ryan for deletion

## Acceptance
- python3 capture.py compare https://anth.us --manifest manifest.json: no status/redirect/header differences; every HTML difference listed and explained.
- All 402 legacy redirects return 301 with the expected Location.
- A test edit is live within 60 s.

## Out of scope
Content model changes; DNS changes (none needed).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M5 (pattern proven on Pilobol.us).

## Risk
Production: downtime care, every production step needs Ryan's explicit yes.

## Estimate
5-8 agent-hours.

## Outcome
pilobol.us is served from its S3 projection bucket through the existing papyrus-edge-pilobol-us distribution; publishing an edit updates the live site in seconds; the Amplify reader dpdg1mg84dlwb is no longer used.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 9 (Migration, Pilobol.us).

## Checklist
- [ ] Pilobol.us site config: backend.publication.kind = "s3-projection"; deploy CMS backend (create-only for the new resources)
- [ ] renditions --all; project-all into the bucket
- [ ] Parity: projected bucket vs today's reader output from the same export (byte-identical) and vs live (capture.py compare)
- [ ] Swap the reader origin on papyrus-edge-pilobol-us to the bucket (OAC) and attach the function; rollback = swap back
- [ ] Remove PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID; time Save -> Live for a test edit
- [ ] Hand the reader app to Ryan for deletion

## Acceptance
- curl https://pilobol.us/ and every sitemap URL: 200, same content-type, HTML sha256 equal to the projected bucket objects.
- A test edit in newsroom.pilobol.us is visible on pilobol.us within 60 s; mutation response has live:true.

## Out of scope
Anth.us; deleting the reader app (Ryan).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1, M2, M3, M4.

## Risk
Low (pre-production; move fast, brief downtime acceptable).

## Estimate
3-5 agent-hours.
